content: भद्रा .²1 A cow. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the second, seventh, and twelfth days of a lunar fortnight. .²3 The celestial Ganges. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of various plants such as अनन्ता, अपरिजाता, कृष्णा, जीवन्ती, नीली, रास्ना <ab>etc.</ab> .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of several goddesses and rivers. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Subhadrā, sister of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma; पार्थश्चैकोऽहरद्भद्राम् <ls>Mb. 8. 31. 2</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">1. 121. 21</ls>.
